sentence: In terms of cancer, numerous studies have documented higher mortality and lower survival rates among Indigenous, compared to non-Indigenous, cohorts. [15][16][17][18][19][20] For example, in the United States, the overall cancer death rates increased significantly for American Indians and Alaskan Natives from 1990 to 2009, whereas overall cancer death rates declined significantly for Whites. [20] In Australia, the 5-year observed survival rate between 2010 and 2014 for all cancers combined was 48% for Indigenous Australians and 59% for non-Indigenous Australians. [19] Indigenous peoples worldwide experience social disadvantage compared to their respective non-Indigenous populations. [21] Poverty, racism, and lack of a culturally responsive health system are reported as important contributors to the cancer burden faced by Indigenous peoples. [22,23] Aspects of the broader social environment can also influence the way individuals and families engage with health care and manage their own health.
